purpose: Replicate the institutional environmental evidence, DMRV, ESG/GHG, water-intelligence and verification framework across Spain without inheriting unsupported measurements or claims from the reference pilot.

administrative_model.source_of_truth: INE municipal and administrative classifications plus authoritative Spanish public geographic sources

node_policy: Every administrative municipality receives a registry node for reporting readiness; physical collection or sensor deployment is never implied by node existence.
coordinate_policy: Administrative geometry may be sourced from authoritative public GIS. Exact physical-site coordinates require survey capture and cross-check; security-sensitive locations remain generalized.
non_contradiction_policy: No cross-country or cross-node value is copied, averaged or promoted without compatible time, space, units, methodology, provenance and quality.
premium_rainwater_policy: Spain nodes may report rainwater opportunity and authorized harvest evidence, but Premium RainWater classification requires the same physical collection, first-flush, custody, QMS, batch, seal, DMRV and regulatory/product-release evidence gates.
blockchain_policy: Blockchain is an integrity and audit layer for deterministic evidence roots; it does not establish environmental truth, water quality or regulatory compliance.
funding_policy: Spain implementation can be presented as measurable infrastructure work packages for grants, builders, public-sector collaboration and institutional funding. Any project token remains outside this pilot until separate legal, accounting, governance and product review.
release_boundary: Administrative coverage is not physical deployment. Reporting readiness is not measured evidence. Measured evidence is not verified product quality. Blockchain anchoring is not regulatory approval.
